gloss: to be frozen with shock; to be flabbergasted

definitions.gloss: to be frozen with shock; to be flabbergasted; to be so surprised one cannot stand
definitions.explanation: To be so startled, frightened, or astonished that one's legs give out and one cannot stand up properly. Literally, one's lower back ({腰|こし}) gives way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧{腰|こし}を{抜|ぬ}かした。
examples.english: I was so surprised I couldn't stand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幽霊|ゆうれい}→幽霊：10648_yuurei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{腰|こし}を{抜|ぬ}かしてしまった。
examples.english: I was paralyzed with shock after seeing a ghost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、{腰|こし}を{抜|ぬ}かすほど⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was flabbergasted when I saw the amount on the bill.

notes:
USAGE:
Can describe either literal inability to stand (from fright) or figurative extreme surprise. Often used hyperbolically.
More vivid and dramatic than simply ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ (to be surprised). Often used for humorous or exaggerated effect, though it can also describe genuine terror.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {腰|こし}を{抜|ぬ}かすほど⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ (to be so surprised one can't stand)
- ～て{腰|こし}を{抜|ぬ}かす (to be paralyzed with shock from ~)
